scope: PackingStar mechanism and reported 26–31D comparison; new constructive improvements only in 95–96D. This is not a comprehensive literature survey.

primary_sources.verification_scope: Source-reported exact verification. Integer-coordinate NPZs are supplied, but their 26–31D configurations were not independently reverified by this update.
primary_sources.observation: README dated 26 October describes joint removals, midpoint insertions and auxiliary layers. Repository includes verification code and data, but no training implementation.

Filler extends feasible Gram matrices; Corrector selects a retained subset, followed by refilling. AATS shares search statistics by rational quadratic-form invariants. Corrector uses a permutation-equivariant network and PPO. These describe the June method, not a disclosed derivation of every October improvement.

transfer_to_this_repository: Apply fill/correct and shared-blocker exchanges to the exact finite support-intersection problem. Search scores are never accepted as a certificate; two independent complete support checks establish the construction.

negative_search.candidate_family: Unused members of the supplied 30240 shortest-body pool, at coefficient Q-norm 30.
observations: None of 29106 unused candidates is compatible with all retained norm-36 points.
Of these, 18846 have at most twelve norm-36 blockers; none survives the fixed affine core.
negative_search.scope: A finite fixed-core screen, not an upper bound or an obstruction to coordinated motion.
